maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is movie tickets, concessions and hotel stays, which are consumer admissions and lodging, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Marcus Theatres and Marcus Hotels & Resorts are paid by consumers, travelers and private groups, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from running and developing its own theatres and hotels, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Moviegoers and hotel guests can easily choose other theatres or hotels; switching has no real cost or disruption.
